prompt.en: Who became the first woman Member of Parliament, in 1921?
prompt.fr: Qui est devenue la première femme députée, en 1921?

options.en: Agnes Macphail, a farmer and teacher.

explanation.en: Agnes Macphail, a farmer and teacher, became the first woman Member of Parliament in 1921, three years after most Canadian women won the federal vote.
explanation.fr: Agnes Macphail, agricultrice et enseignante, est devenue la première femme députée en 1921, trois ans après que la plupart des Canadiennes eurent obtenu le droit de vote fédéral.

source.quote: In 1921 Agnes Macphail, a farmer and teacher, became the first woman MP.
